_comment: Our own ingredient → USDA mapping. A SUPERSET, not an amendment.
usda.db is reference data. It is gitignored, rebuilt by
`bun scripts/build-usda-db.ts`, and never edited: amending it in place would
be destroyed on the next rebuild, and would quietly detach the nutrition
figures from the published USDA release they claim to come from. The whole
value of USDA is that it is citable, and an edited copy is not.
So our knowledge lives here instead, in version control, where each decision
carries a reason and shows up in a diff. Same principle as curated.json
against sources.db: the decision file is tracked, the derived database is
2. a `pattern` in this file (substring, checked longest-first)
3. the full-text search heuristics in to-grams.ts
fdcId   — the USDA record to use. Look it up in the admin's USDA foods tab.
note    — why this mapping, especially when the obvious match was wrong.
reject  — true to say 'this is not a food' (e.g. 'to taste'), so the
heuristics are not given a chance to invent something.

ground beef.note: Beef, ground, 80% lean / 20% fat, raw. The default for meatloaf; heuristics reached corned beef.

milk.note: Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat. Heuristics reached 'Crackers, milk' and 'Milk dessert, frozen'.

egg.note: Egg, whole, raw, fresh. Chosen over the Foundation record because it publishes every size: small 38 g, medium 44, large 50, extra large 56, jumbo 63.

eggs.note: Egg, whole, raw, fresh. Chosen over the Foundation record because it publishes every size: small 38 g, medium 44, large 50, extra large 56, jumbo 63.

large eggs.note: Egg, whole, raw, fresh. Chosen over the Foundation record because it publishes every size: small 38 g, medium 44, large 50, extra large 56, jumbo 63.

garlic.note: Garlic, raw. 'garlic cloves' matched 'Spices, cloves, ground' — the unit word is also a food.

ketchup.note: Catsup. USDA files the cup portion under the older spelling; the 'Ketchup' records carry none.

onion.note: Onions, raw. Carries whole-onion portions: medium 110 g, large 150 g.

yellow onion.note: See onion; 'Onions, yellow, sauteed' is the only yellow record and it is cooked.

celery.note: Celery, raw. Stalk portions: small 17 g, medium 40, large 64.

bread crumb.note: Bread, crumbs, dry, grated, plain. Covers breadcrumb, bread crumbs, Italian bread crumbs.

kosher salt.note: Salt, table. Kosher differs by crystal size, not composition.

black pepper.note: Spices, pepper, black. Heuristics reached 'Peppers, bell, red, raw'.

olive oil.note: Oil, olive, salad or cooking. Covers extra virgin.
